description: Read one public web page as clean Markdown (title, main text, headings, lists, links) with word count, a SHA-256 content hash and the provider receipt. APIbase pays the provider per call over x402; your payment is settled only when the page is delivered. Source: Inferrail Web Read.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the web page to read (e.g. "https://example.com/")

name: inferrail.web.read_page

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Inferrail Web Read
